name: crypt-ts
tagline: Authenticated encryption, signing, and secure random for Node.js — safe defaults over node:crypto, with byte-for-byte interop with the Go crypt.
description: crypt-ts (@ubgo/crypt) is a TypeScript/Node.js cryptography toolkit: AES-256-GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption, HMAC and Ed25519 signing, HKDF key derivation, key rotation (KeyRing), time-locked tokens, X25519 sealed-box asymmetric encryption, and CSPRNG helpers — wrapped around node:crypto with safe defaults, zero runtime dependencies, dual ESM+CJS output, and a versioned wire format that is byte-for-byte interoperable with the Go counterpart github.com/ubgo/crypt.

positioning.audience: Node/TypeScript backend engineers who need correct crypto without hand-rolling node:crypto's mutable Cipher API.
positioning.wedge: Encrypt a value (or sign a webhook) in one line, authenticated by default, and read the exact same bytes from a Go service.
differentiators: Authenticated by default (AES-256-GCM / ChaCha20-Poly1305) — no update()/final() footguns from the raw node:crypto Cipher API.
Byte-for-byte interop with the Go twin github.com/ubgo/crypt via a shared known-answer vector file in CI.
Versioned wire format so new algorithms slot in without breaking decrypt of old data.
Zero runtime dependencies (node:crypto only); strict TypeScript; dual ESM + CJS build.
Batteries included: KeyRing rotation, HKDF, time-locked tokens, Ed25519, X25519 sealed-box.
